title: RecordingImport
description: import.json of an imported replay set on the PC, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): written by pnpm rec import in .data/fixtures/recordings/<recording_id>/, and updated by pnpm rec review and when a quarantine is carried over. Never leaves the PC. Checked by pnpm rec import, not by this schema: each deletion's id is the recording's or one of the session's capture ids, frame is the file's frame, and the file is gone.

recording_version.description: Version of the session recording format.

reviewed_at.description: When the owner last reviewed it, or null until pnpm rec review.

recheck.description: The face re-check's run, or null for a set with no images.

deleted.description: Every file deleted by the re-check or by a quarantine carried over from ingest. At most 60000.

recheck.title: ImportRecheck
recheck.description: The server's face re-check over every image in the set.

images_deleted.description: Images deleted because a face was still sharp.

path.description: Its path in the replay set: a recording's candidate, depth or confidence image, or a bundle's keyframe, depth or confidence image.

reason.title: ImportDeletionReason
reason.description: recheck: the face re-check found a sharp face. quarantine: ingest quarantined the frame.
